idea-plugin.name: Payroll Deduction Code Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Twelve rules over the deduction-code map, before the January 31 W-2 filing date

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Payroll Deduction Code Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/payroll-deduction-code-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/payroll-deduction-code-audit

action.text: Payroll Deduction Code Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Payroll Deduction Code Audit on the file in the editor
